stimulus: "Where are you right now?" "Why?" "I heard of an accident in your office. So, I got worried." said, The father, "Oh, I see, I am safe in my office. Don't worry," said the son.
guide_solution: Rafiq told me that he had got GPA-5 in the SSC exam. I congratulated him and asked him what he intended to do then. Rafiq replied that he wanted to study in a reputed college. He added that he would try to get admission in Notre Dame College.
